payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute longest common prefix (LCP) for all pairs of word suffixes using 2D DP (dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j+1] + 1 if words equal), then iterate over segments to find optimal abbreviation with non-overlapping occurrences.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP table where state depends on adjacent states (i+1, j+1) to precompute equality of segments, a hallmark of dp_2d_state.
